verdict.rationale: Bench's documented AI is limited to transaction categorization and rule generation, and its card "real-time transaction monitoring" is a related but different feature. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent that watches the ledger and flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before close, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
